summary.name: Me.bot
summary.one_liner: Me.bot (Second Me) is a personal AI companion that learns from your notes, voice recordings and ideas to help you create and present talks in your own voice.
keywords: ai that learns from your notes
use_cases: turn ideas into voice and visual presentations
tailor a message for different audiences
create interactive talks with live audience engagement
simplify complex topics into stories for social media
summary.what_it_does: Me.bot lets you build a personal AI version of yourself ("Second Me") by importing notes, audio, and voice recordings or meetings, plus jotting down thoughts. You then pick an audience and topic, and it generates a talk with voice and visuals based on your records. Talks can be shared, and audiences can interact live, with the creator getting engagement insights. The page says data is handled via a per-user "Large Personal Model" and cites anonymity, end-to-end encryption, and Azure Confidential Computing, though these claims are marketing statements not independently verified here.
notable: Builds a personal AI voice and presentations from your own notes and recordings
Interactive presentations with live audience engagement insights
Claims Azure Confidential Computing and local-device data encryption
caveats: Freemium pricing is taken from the directory listing; the page itself does not state tier details
Privacy and encryption claims are marketing statements and not independently verified
